x: He could not hold Yates, of S.L.H., but just managed to beat Carmen, of the Poly, by inches for fifth position. Blackheath beat Herne Hill for first place, with Mitcham A.C. third.

Tony Fairclough was ranked 7th in the Juniors behind Yates, Hammond, Edwards (Scot), McCafferty (Scot), Walker and Watters. For some reason the Youths' rankings were only taken down to six, but John Bicourt can feel confident he would have been placed 8th.

A strong field assembled for the start and having been introduced as one of the 'stars' present, Gerry found himself in the company of such names as Adcocks, Price, Ingleton and Yates as they sped off on the first of three laps.

I have this theory that Matthew Yates will do something special in the 1500 metres and others seem to agree with me. He has that arrogance and blazing speed and is an "unknown" - if only he can get up and stay near the front.
